exec: pm.test("Pesan error memuat: Stok tidak mencukupi", function () { const m = [].concat(body.message).join(' | '); pm.expect(m).to.include("Stok tidak mencukupi"); });

pm.test("stok per produk", function () { const a = body.data.find(p => p.sku === "ELK-001"); const b = body.data.find(p => p.sku === "ELK-002"); pm.expect(a.stock).to.eql(80); pm.expect(a.is_low_stock).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.stock).to.eql(60); });

pm.test("gudang cabang: produk B = 10, produk A = 0", function () { const a = body.data.find(p => p.sku === "ELK-001"); const b = body.data.find(p => p.sku === "ELK-002"); pm.expect(a.stock).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.stock).to.eql(10); });
